items.title: Le CCM alloue plus de 26 MDH au soutien de 40 festivals cinématographiques
items.description: Le Centre cinématographique marocain (CCM) consacrera une enveloppe globale de 26,46 millions de dirhams au soutien de 40 festivals et manifestations cinématographiques à travers le Royaume. Cette décision a été prise par la Commission de soutien à l'organisation des festivals cinématographiques, réunie les 21 et 23 juillet à Rabat. Au total, 55 dossiers ont été examinés. Les organisateurs ont été auditionnés afin de présenter et défendre leurs projets avant la sélection finale, indique un communiqué du CCM. Le Festival international du film de Marrakech demeure le principal bénéficiaire avec une subvention de 12 millions de dirhams. Le Festival national du film de Tanger, organisé par le CCM, recevra pour sa part 7,5 millions de dirhams pour sa prochaine édition. Parmi les autres manifestations soutenues figurent le Festival du cinéma méditerranéen de Tétouan, qui bénéficiera de 1,2 million de dirhams, le Festival international du film de femmes de Salé avec 1 million de dirhams, ainsi que le Festival international du cinéma d'auteur de Rabat, doté de 800.000 dirhams. Le Festival international du film maghrébin d'Oujda recevra 480.000 dirhams, tandis que le Festival international du film transsaharien de Zagora et le Festival international du cinéma de montagne d'Ouzoud bénéficieront chacun d'une subvention de 300.000 dirhams. La Commission a également accordé 250.000 dirhams au Festival international du cinéma et mémoire commune de Nador, et 200.000 dirhams respectivement au Festival international cinéma et migrations d'Agadir et au Festival international des écoles de cinéma de Tétouan. Plusieurs autres rendez-vous cinématographiques à travers le Royaume bénéficieront d'aides comprises entre 170.000 et 30.000 dirhams. Parmi eux figurent notamment le Marrakech Short Film Festival, le Festival national du film d'amateurs de Settat, le Festival international du cinéma et de la mer de Mirleft, le Festival Rabat-Comedy, le Festival du court métrage marocain de Sidi Kacem, le Tanger Film Festival, le Festival du cinéma de Saïdia, le Festival de Fès Ciné-ville, le Festival cinéma des peuples d'Imouzzer, le Festival international du film documentaire de Khouribga, le Festival Issni N'Ourgh du film amazigh, le Festival Tanja Zoom, le Festival Handifilm de Rabat ou encore les Journées cinématographiques de Doukkala. À travers cette enveloppe de plus de 26 millions de dirhams, le CCM entend poursuivre son soutien à la diversité des manifestations cinématographiques marocaines, qu'elles soient d'envergure internationale ou ancrées dans les différentes régions du Royaume, afin de renforcer la dynamique du secteur et de promouvoir la création cinématographique nationale. The post Le CCM alloue plus de 26 MDH au soutien de 40 festivals cinématographiques appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: Michael Blackson’s claims on late mother’s care inaccurate – UGMC
items.description: The University of Ghana Medical Centre Ltd. (UGMC) has disputed claims made by Ghanaian-American comedian Michael Blackson regarding the care provided to his late mother, saying some of the issues raised on social media contain inaccuracies. In a statement issued on Wednesday, August 5, UGMC extended its condolences to Mr Blackson and his family following the death of his 83-year-old mother at the facility on July 16, 2026. The Centre said it takes feedback from patients and their families seriously and had reviewed the concerns raised “thoroughly, fairly and objectively” in line with its clinical and administrative processes. However, UGMC said its review found that several claims made by Mr Blackson about his mother’s treatment did not accurately reflect what occurred during her care at the facility. “The facts presented by Mr. Blackson on social media contain numerous inaccuracies and do not accurately reflect the events that transpired in the provision of medical care to his 83-year-old mother,” the statement said. Mr Blackson’s mother was referred to UGMC from a peripheral hospital and received care at the facility from May 27 to July 16, 2026, a period of about eight weeks. UGMC, however, said it would not disclose details of her diagnosis, treatment or medical records due to its obligation to protect patient confidentiality, which remains in place even after a patient’s death. “Out of respect for the dignity of the deceased and the privacy of her family, we will not disclose or discuss in the public domain the details of any patient’s diagnosis, treatment, medical records, or account of care,” the Centre stated. The medical facility maintained that all clinical decisions are made by qualified healthcare professionals based on established medical standards and in the best interest of patients, adding that such decisions are taken in consultation with authorised family representatives where necessary. UGMC also addressed a reported incident involving an alleged physical assault of Mr Blackson’s sister and a member of staff, saying the matter has been referred to the appropriate law enforcement authorities. The Centre said it would not comment further on the issue while the matter remains with the relevant authorities. UGMC said it remains willing to engage with the family privately through appropriate channels and assured that any specific allegations of misconduct by staff would be investigated and, where necessary, referred to the appropriate bodies. The Centre also encouraged members of the public with concerns about their experiences to contact its Client Services team for review and resolution.

items.title: Why we froze Osun govt bank accounts – EFCC
items.description: By Luminous Jannamike The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission, EFCC, on Wednesday night defended its decision to freeze the Osun State Government’s bank accounts, insisting the action was aimed at stopping the alleged diversion of about N11 billion in public funds under investigation and was not connected with the state’s forthcoming governorship election. The anti-graft agency said it stepped in after investigators uncovered what it described as an unusual wave of fund transfers from government accounts into several corporate entities, arguing that allowing the transactions to continue would have amounted to looking the other way while public money was allegedly being siphoned out. In a statement by its Head of Media and Publicity, Dele Oyewale, the Commission said it had been investigating the Osun State Government since March 2026 over the alleged fraudulent handling of Ecology Funds, Intervention Funds and allocations from the Federation Account Allocation Committee, FAAC, amounting to N11 billion. It added that the state’s Accountant-General and other government officials had already appeared before its investigators. “The Commission cannot watch idly while a state government’s account is being pillaged,” the statement said. According to the Commission, the ongoing investigation alone would not have prompted a Post No Debit order on the state’s accounts. “These ongoing investigations of the state government would not have warranted any placement of Post No Debit order on its account but for the precipitate and unwarranted movement of funds from the accounts to different suspicious accounts since August 2, 2026. “The Commission noticed huge transfers of funds into different corporate entities and had to swiftly halt the trend by freezing the accounts from which such heavy funds are being moved,” EFCC said. The Commission said its intervention was consistent with its statutory responsibility to protect public funds and insisted that the proximity of the governorship election could not justify inaction. “While the Commission is fully aware of the impending governorship election in Osun State, it has a responsibility to act in defence of the sanctity of the funds of the state. It will be uncharitable for the Commission to allow an excuse of an upcoming election to fold its arms to perform its legally-assigned functions,” the statement added. The Commission also disclosed that Osun was not the only state under scrutiny, saying similar financial investigations were underway elsewhere as part of its efforts to enforce accountability in the management of public resources. “It is equally needful to state that the Commission is keeping watch over the finances of other states like Osun State. Many of these states are on the investigative radar of the Commission to ensure accountability and probity,” the anti-graft agency said. Maintaining that its operations were driven solely by the public interest, the EFCC rejected suggestions of political bias, saying its actions were guided by law rather than partisan considerations. “The Commission has always pointed out that it is non-partisan and non-sectarian but always working in the overall interests of Nigerians. The Osun State government account was frozen to save public funds from being looted,” the Commission maintained. The anti-graft agency urged Nigerians to disregard what it described as false narratives aimed at discrediting its work, assuring the public that it would continue to act to safeguard public resources. items.title: Qui est Marine Dafeur, la nouvelle star du football féminin en Algérie ?
items.description: L'équipe d'Algérie féminine de football est en quarts de finale de la CAN 2026 pour la deuxième fois de suite, grâce notamment à sa star Marine Dafeur. Elle rencontrera la Côte d’Ivoire le 8 août pour une place dans le dernier carré de la compétition. Au premier tour, les Algériennes ont montré de belles choses depuis le début du tournoi qui se déroule au Maroc. Elles doivent particulièrement une fière chandelle à leur coéquipière Marine Dafeur. Marine Dafeur : un but qui rappelle les tirs de Roberto Carlos Depuis la soirée du lundi 3 août, la presse sportive en Algérie, en Afrique et ailleurs parle de son but somptueux face au Kenya (2-0) pour le troisième match de la phase de poules. Il est vrai que de tels chefs-d'œuvre, on en voit rarement sur les terrains de foot. Un coup franc magistral botté du pied gauche à 25 mètres des buts et qui finit dans la lucarne. « Roberta Carlossa », s'amusent à comparer certains internautes. À juste titre, car un tel tir est digne de l'ancien arrière-gauche du Brésil et du Real Madrid, Roberto Carlos. Pour beaucoup, le but est assuré d'ores et déjà d'être le plus beau du tournoi. Le but marqué après un quart d’heure de jeu sera suivi d’un deuxième inscrit par Lynda Bendris sept minutes plus tard et permet aux Algériennes de l’emporter sur le score de 2-0. C’est la deuxième victoire de l’Algérie dans le tournoi après celle obtenue lors de la première journée sur le même score face au Sénégal. Défaites par les Marocaines (1-0), les Algériennes ont terminé deuxièmes du groupe et se sont qualifiées pour les quarts de finale où elles affronteront les Ivoiriennes samedi 8 août. Marine Dafeur est la star de l’Algérie dans ce tournoi. Elle en est à son deuxième but après le penalty inscrit face au Sénégal. Marine Dafeur est passée par l’équipe de France A En trois ans et 22 matchs, elle a inscrit 7 buts sous le maillot national et délivré 4 passes décisives. Âgée de 31 ans (née en octobre 1994), Marine Dafeur a rejoint la sélection du pays de ses origines sur le tard, en 2023, après être passée chez les catégories jeunes de l’équipe de France, et même chez l'équipe A. Née à Auby, dans le nord de la France, elle a entamé sa carrière à Hénin-Beaumont, avant de passer successivement chez Guingamp, Lille, Fleury et Bristol (Angleterre) où elle évolue depuis 2025 comme arrière latéral et milieu gauche. Chez les Bleues, elle a été sélectionnée en U19, U20 et U23 entre 2011 et 2014. Elle est notamment championne d’Europe U19 en 2013 et troisième de la Coupe du monde U20 en 2014. Elle sera ensuite sélectionnée à deux reprises en équipe de France première en 2014 et 2015. N’ayant plus été convoquée chez les Bleues, elle a opté pour la nationalité sportive algérienne en 2023. Elle a notamment contribué au passage de l'équipe nationale aux quarts de finale de la CAN 2024 où elle a été battue aux tirs au but par le Ghana. L’article Qui est Marine Dafeur, la nouvelle star du football féminin en Algérie ? est apparu en premier sur TSA .

items.title: Trump’s ‘Liberation Day’ tariff refunds hit $100bn
items.description: Donald Trump’s administration has paid back $100bn (£78bn) in “Liberation Day” tariff refunds to businesses through US customs officials. This represents roughly 60% of all tariff revenue collected by the government under the policy, according to a recent court filing from US Customs and Border Protection. However, a significant chunk of money remains unpaid. Nearly $29bn in potential refunds is undergoing review by trade authorities, while another $1.6bn remains stuck because importers have not yet supplied their banking details. The repayments follow a major Supreme Court decision in February , in which judges ruled that broad import tariffs introduced under economic powers were unlawful. The White House had cited a 1977 law, the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA), which gives the president power to “regulate” trade in response to an emergency. But the measures sparked outcry at home and abroad from firms facing an abrupt rise in taxes on shipments entering the US, and worries that the levies would lead to higher prices. Tariffs are taxes on foreign goods entering a country. They are not paid by foreign governments or overseas exporters, but by domestic businesses and importers when goods arrive at customs. Higher tariffs raise upfront business expenses, and companies usually pass these extra costs to shoppers through higher retail prices.

items.title: Azzedine Ounahi attise les convoitises des cadors européens
items.description: L'avenir d'Azzedine Ounahi pourrait animer les dernières semaines du mercato estival. Selon les informations de Mundo Deportivo, l'international marocain suscite l'intérêt de plusieurs clubs européens de premier plan, séduits par ses performances malgré la relégation de Gérone en deuxième division. Le milieu de terrain des Lions de l'Atlas figurerait notamment sur les tablettes du FC Barcelone, du Real Madrid, de Villarreal, de l'Ajax Amsterdam et de Manchester City. Ces formations suivent de près l'évolution de son dossier, alors que son départ semble de plus en plus probable cet été. Le Barça étudierait la piste Ounahi afin de renforcer son entrejeu, notamment après la blessure de Frenkie de Jong. Le club catalan considérerait le Marocain comme une option intéressante sur le plan sportif et financier. L'Ajax apparaît également comme un prétendant sérieux. Le club néerlandais a déjà entamé des discussions avec Gérone et l'entourage du joueur. Un atout pourrait jouer en sa faveur : son nouvel entraîneur, Míchel Sánchez, connaît parfaitement Ounahi pour l'avoir dirigé à Gérone et souhaiterait en faire une priorité de recrutement. De son côté, Manchester City surveillerait également la situation du milieu marocain, tandis que le Real Madrid et Villarreal auraient manifesté leur intérêt sans avoir encore formulé d'offre officielle. Sous contrat avec Gérone, Azzedine Ounahi dispose d'une clause libératoire de 25 millions d'euros, mais plusieurs médias espagnols estiment qu'un transfert pourrait être conclu pour un montant inférieur si les négociations aboutissent. À quelques semaines de la clôture du marché des transferts, le dossier de l'international marocain s'annonce comme l'un des plus suivis de l'été. items.title: Third-term agenda has never served Africa well – Dr Asah-Asante cautions
items.description: A Senior Political Science Lecturer at the University of Ghana, Legon, Dr Asah-Asante, has cautioned against any move that could undermine Ghana’s democratic stability, citing the negative experiences of third-term presidential bids across Africa. Speaking on JoyFM’s Top Story on Wednesday, August 5, Dr Asah-Asante said while individuals have the constitutional right to seek interpretation of legal matters from the Supreme Court, the broader implications of a possible third-term agenda must be carefully considered. He noted that Ghana must draw lessons from other African countries where attempts by leaders to extend their stay in office created political tensions. “Let us know that it’s everybody’s right to go to court and seek redress whenever there is an issue that he or she does not have the interpretation. So we can’t take that right from them,” he said. “However, the issue of third-term agenda is a big issue, and we should not just look at Ghana, look at the experience in Africa so that we can be very careful when we are dealing with our democracy,” he added. Dr Asah-Asante referenced countries including Algeria, Cameroon, Chad, Djibouti, Gabon, Guinea, Malawi and Namibia, where third-term extensions have occurred, arguing that such developments have often been associated with democratic challenges. “The story of the third-term agenda has never been a good one,” he said. According to him, Ghana’s democratic journey, despite existing challenges, has provided the country with stability and must be protected from actions that could create uncertainty. “The way this democracy has served us, in spite of a few lingering challenges, it has done its best for us, and we have had stability. So anything that would toy with this democracy and make it difficult to run, I’m afraid we should shy away from,” he stated. Three individuals have filed suits at the Supreme Court seeking interpretation of Article 66 of the 1992 Constitution, which deals with presidential term limits. Dr Asah-Asante said he expects the apex court to deliver a decision that will provide clarity and settle the debate surrounding the matter. “I have hope that the Supreme Court would deliver the judgment that will stand the test of time, and it will lay to rest all the noise that is around this subject,” he said.

items.title: Tinubu lauds rescue of 308 kidnap victims in Kwara, Niger
items.description: By Johnbosco Agbakwuru President Bola Tinubu has warmly welcomed the successful rescue of 308 Nigerian citizens who were abducted in different attacks in Niger and Kwara states. One hundred and sixty-three of those rescued were abducted from Woro Community in Kaiama LGA, Kwara State, and 145 from Niger State. The victims were rescued from the Kainji Lake National Park Forest in New Bussa Local Government Area of Niger State following a coordinated, intelligence-driven operation by the National Counter-Terrorism Centre (NCTC), involving personnel from the Armed Forces of Nigeria, the Department of State Services (DSS), and the Nigeria Police Force. It was the largest rescue operation ever carried out on the same day by the joint security team. President Tinubu expressed deep appreciation to the leadership and personnel of the security agencies for their bravery, seamless inter-agency collaboration, and dedication, which made the recovery of the victims possible. “The successful execution of this intelligence-led operation demonstrates the growing efficiency and collaboration among our security services. I commend our gallant men and women in uniform for their bravery and unwavering commitment to safeguarding Nigerian lives,” the President stated. The rescued citizens are receiving first aid and essential medical care at the Medical facility at Wawa Cantonment. Upon completion of their medical evaluations, they will be formally handed over to their state governments for comprehensive care and reunification with their families. While applauding the return of the victims, President Tinubu emphasised the imperative of bolstering national security infrastructure to prevent future occurrences. The President directed security agencies and relevant stakeholders to immediately strengthen early warning mechanisms, enhance community-level intelligence gathering, and improve rapid response capabilities to avert similar incidents across the country. He reassured all Nigerians that his administration remains steadfast in its resolve to eliminate security threats, protect vulnerable communities, and restore lasting peace across every corner of the nation. items.title: “Ask Asiedu Nketia what he means” – NPP rejects claim it created Mahama third-term debate
items.description: The New Patriotic Party (NPP) has rejected claims by the National Democratic Congress (NDC) National Chairman, Johnson Asiedu Nketia, that the party manufactured the debate over President John Mahama’s eligibility to seek a third term. The NPP Director of Communications, Richard Ahiagbah, speaking on Joy FM’s Top Story on Wednesday, August 5, questioned why the party should be blamed for a matter that is currently before the Supreme Court for constitutional interpretation. According to him, the issue arose from the need to clarify whether Ghana’s constitutional provision on presidential term limits applies only to consecutive terms or also covers non-consecutive terms. “You should ask Chairman Asiedu Nketiah what he means by that. I don’t understand what he means by that. I don’t know what he means by that. That it’s a creation of the New Patriotic Party,” he said. He argued that the NPP cannot be held responsible for seeking clarity on a constitutional matter, stressing that the Constitution belongs to all Ghanaians and not any political party. “Are we the ones who have taken the case to the Supreme Court for interpretation of a non-consecutive two terms?” he questioned. The NPP Director of Communications said the discussion was a serious constitutional matter that required clarity, rather than political commentary. He explained that the key question was whether a president who serves two terms separated by a break in office could be eligible to serve again, adding that any interpretation from the Supreme Court would have implications for Ghana’s democracy. “There is a need to understand whether two terms means that you go consecutively, or when there’s a break, it is a one term, and then you can go consecutively two terms,” he said. He further insisted that the party’s concerns were not driven by political interests but by the need to protect the integrity of the constitutional order. According to him, if the Supreme Court determines that non-consecutive terms should be counted differently, it would raise questions about who stands to benefit from such an interpretation. “When they are telling you this thing that NPP is pushing this conversation, you should ask yourself if you are not concerned about that,” he said. His comments follow remarks by Johnson Asiedu Nketia suggesting that the NPP introduced the President Mahama third-term debate to create confusion within the NDC. The NPP Director of Communications maintained that the matter should not be treated lightly, insisting that constitutional issues require serious national attention.

items.title: Infantino offers Morocco World Cup final in exchange for support
items.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino is reportedly attempting to secure Morocco’s backing amid mounting pressure over his leadership and the collapse of a controversial plan involving private investment in World Cup commercial rights. According to a report by The Mirror , Infantino has allegedly offered Morocco the opportunity to host the 2030 World Cup final at the planned Hassan II Stadium in Casablanca. The proposed venue, which is expected to have a capacity of 115,000, could reportedly replace Madrid’s Santiago Bernabeu as the location for the tournament’s showpiece match. However, the report claims the alleged offer is conditional on Morocco publicly supporting Infantino as he faces growing criticism and calls for him to leave office. Infantino is currently in Morocco for meetings with FIFA officials as he attempts to navigate the crisis surrounding his presidency. Morocco is set to stage the 2030 World Cup alongside Spain and Portugal and has maintained a strong relationship with Infantino during his time leading FIFA. That relationship could become increasingly important as the FIFA president attempts to shore up support within the organisation. The report also claims Infantino is concerned about a perceived decline in backing from Saudi Arabia, which will host the 2034 World Cup. The reported approach to Morocco comes after Infantino’s controversial plan to bring private investment into the World Cup was abandoned, intensifying scrutiny of his leadership. items.title: Lawyers for Hanan Wahab, Adu-Boahene protest vacation trials in petition to Chief Justice
items.description: Lawyers representing Abdul-Hanan Wahab and former National Signals Bureau Director-General Kwabena Adu-Boahene have written separately to the Chief Justice protesting the decision to allow their criminal trials to proceed during the judicial legal vacation. The two legal teams, led by former Attorney-General Godfred Yeboah Dame for Abdul-Hanan Wahab and Samuel Atta Akyea for Kwabena Adu-Boahene, contend that commencing the trials during the vacation is inconsistent with long-standing judicial practice and the rules governing the sittings of the Superior Courts. In their respective letters dated August 5, the lawyers informed the Chief Justice that they would not participate in proceedings scheduled during the legal vacation. In a letter on behalf of Abdul-Hanan Wahab, Mr Dame said the trial judge informed the parties at the previous sitting that he had received authorisation to hear the case during the vacation and advised that any concerns should be directed to the Chief Justice. The letter argues that the trial had not yet commenced before the vacation and therefore should not be listed for hearing during the period. According to the defence, the decision departs from established practice under which High Court business is ordinarily conducted during the regular legal term, except in limited circumstances. Similarly, Samuel Atta Akyea, acting for Kwabena Adu-Boahene, objected to the vacation hearing, arguing that there were no exceptional circumstances warranting the matter being heard during the judicial recess. The lawyers contend that criminal trials that have not commenced should not ordinarily be initiated during the legal vacation and insist that the scheduled hearings should instead take place when the courts resume their regular sittings. Both legal teams have consequently notified the Chief Justice that they will not attend proceedings scheduled during the vacation. The development introduces a fresh procedural challenge in the two high-profile criminal cases, with attention now turning to whether the Chief Justice or the trial courts will respond to the objections raised by the defence.

items.title: Islamabad raises Afghan terrorism concerns at UN Security Council
items.description: WASHINGTON: Pakistan on Wednesday informed the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) that multiple terrorist groups continued to operate from safe havens inside Afghanistan, posing a growing threat to regional security. Speaking at a UNSC briefing on threats to international peace and security caused by terrorist acts, Pakistan’s Permanent Representative to the UN Ambassador Asim Iftikhar Ahmad also highlighted Islamabad’s concerns over Jammu and Kashmir, as the Council met on the seventh anniversary of India’s August 5, 2019, decision to revoke the region’s special constitutional status. Ahmad described the measures imposed on that day as a new phase of repression against the Kashmiri people and accused India of committing what he called “state terrorism” in the disputed territory. He said the international community must show “zero tolerance” for such actions and should not allow counterterrorism efforts to be used as a pretext to suppress what Pakistan describes as legitimate struggles for self-determination. The Kashmir reference came alongside a broader discussion of terrorism and regional security, with the ambassador focusing heavily on Afghanistan-based terrorist groups — an issue that has become central to Pakistan’s security concerns and increasingly part of Washington’s regional agenda. The UN remarks followed the fourth US-Pakistan Counterterrorism Dialogue held on Tuesday in Washington, where both countries reaffirmed their commitment to combating terrorist organisations and strengthening security cooperation. In his address to the Council, Ahmad said that while sustained international counter-terrorism efforts had degraded the capabilities of groups such as the militant Islamic State, the terrorist threat continued to evolve, particularly in parts of Africa, the Middle East and Afghanistan. He said Islamic State’s Khorasan chapter (IS-K) had suffered setbacks, including because of counter-terrorism operations by Pakistan, but continued to pose a significant concern, particularly in Afghanistan. “The situation in Afghanistan remains deeply alarming,” Ambassador Ahmad told the Council. “Since the Taliban takeover in August 2021, multiple terrorist groups continue to thrive in that country in an increasingly permissive environment.” He specifically named the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), the Balochistan Liberation Army (BLA) and its Majeed Brigade, IS-K and its affiliates, the East Turkistan Islamic Movement (ETIM) and Al Qaeda affiliates as groups that, according to Pakistan, have access to safe havens inside Afghanistan. Pakistan has repeatedly accused the TTP of using Afghan territory to plan and carry out attacks inside Pakistan, a charge that Taliban authorities have rejected. Islamabad has also accused external actors of supporting terrorist groups operating against Pakistan. The ambassador urged the Taliban authorities to fulfil their obligation to ensure that Afghan territory is not used by any terrorist organisation to threaten other countries. He also called for international action against what he described as external sponsors of terrorism. The US-Pakistan counter-terrorism dialogue reflected a similar focus on Afghanistan-based terrorist groups. Counter-terrorism has emerged as one of the areas where the two countries continue to see a clear convergence of interests. Later in his UNSC speech, Ambassador Ahmad returned to Kashmir, linking the issue to Pakistan’s broader argument that international security frameworks should address all forms of terrorism, including what Islamabad calls “state terrorism” resulting from foreign occupation. He argued that the global response to terrorism must avoid double standards and selectivity, saying that all groups posing a threat to international peace and security should be addressed through a consistent approach. The ambassador concluded that terrorism “knows no borders” and “has no religion,” calling for a coordinated international effort to combat the threat. According to the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies , an Islamabad-based think tank, violence linked to terrorist attacks and counter-terrorism operations intensified sharply in July, making it the deadliest month of 2026, with 112 security personnel among 205 people killed.

items.title: Garango : Une boulangerie fermée pour dix jours pour manquements aux règles d'hygiène
items.description: Dans le cadre de ses missions de contrôle, la Direction régionale en charge du Commerce du Nakambé (DRICA-Nakambé) a mené, le mardi 4 août 2026, une opération d'inspection dans plusieurs boulangeries de la ville de Garango. Cette sortie visait à vérifier le respect des prix réglementaires ainsi que des normes d'hygiène en vigueur. Selon des informations publiées ce mercredi 5 août 2026 sur la page Facebook du ministère en charge du commerce, l'une des boulangeries contrôlées a été sanctionnée pour des insuffisances en matière d'hygiène. Les autorités ont ordonné sa fermeture temporaire pour une durée de dix jours, à compter du 5 août 2026, afin de permettre au promoteur de réaliser les travaux de réfection nécessaires et de mettre son établissement en conformité avec les exigences sanitaires. En plus de cette mesure administrative, le responsable de la boulangerie a été contraint de payer une amende pour insuffisance d'hygiène dans sa boulangerie. À travers cette opération, la DRICA-Nakambé appelle les opérateurs économiques à observer scrupuleusement les normes d'hygiène et de santé publique dans l'exercice de leurs activités. items.title: 140 millions d’euros : le Real Madrid casse sa tirelire pour Yan Diomandé
items.description: Le feuilleton estival du Real Madrid tient son épilogue. Selon les informations de The Athletic, confirmées par L'Équipe, le club merengue tient un accord avec le RB Leipzig pour Yan Diomandé. La facture s'annonce vertigineuse : environ 140 millions d'euros, dont 125 millions fixes et 15 millions de bonus. L'opération tombe à point nommé pour une Maison-Blanche empêtrée dans un autre dossier brûlant, celui de la prolongation de Vinicius Junior. Pendant que le Brésilien fait patienter sa direction, c'est un autre profil offensif, plus jeune et déjà courtisé par toute l'Europe, qui s'apprête à débarquer dans la capitale espagnole. L'ailier ivoirien, à peine 19 ans, avait pourtant l’embarras du choix. Le PSG et Liverpool s'étaient positionnés sur son dossier, sans parvenir à devancer l'écurie madrilène. Diomandé, lui, a tranché : c'est au Real qu'il veut écrire la suite de sa jeune carrière. Il ne reste plus qu'une formalité pour sceller définitivement le transfert : la validation de l'opération par le club allemand. Une fois ce feu vert obtenu, l'international ivoirien s'envolera pour Madrid, direction la clinique, pour y passer sa visite médicale. Un an après avoir explosé en Bundesliga, l'enfant prodige de Leipzig s'apprête à changer de dimension.

items.title: Entrepreneuriat en Guinée : 300 entrepreneurs reçoivent leurs attestations de formation
items.description: Le ministère de l’Emploi, du Travail et de la Protection sociale, à travers l’AGUIPE-E (Agence guinéenne pour la promotion de l’emploi et de l’entrepreneuriat), a organisé, ce mercredi 5 août 2026, la cérémonie officielle de remise des attestations à 300 entrepreneurs. Cette formation a été réalisée grâce à l’appui du programme « FIERE » d’Enabel et à l’appui technique du consortium Fanaka & Co et Dream for Africa. Elle s’inscrit dans le cadre du programme d’accompagnement des porteurs de projets et des jeunes NEET. Elle a touché les régions de Conakry, Kindia et Mamou. « Cette cérémonie ne marque pas seulement la clôture d’un programme pilote. Elle consacre une évolution majeure de l’AGUIPE-E à travers l’intégration de l’accompagnement entrepreneurial comme service structuré du service public de l’emploi. Avec l’appui du programme FIERE d’Enabel, nous avons accompagné 292 jeunes, dont 148 NEET — jeunes sans emploi, ni études, ni formation — et 144 porteurs de projets à Conakry, Kindia et Mamou. Ils ont été formés, coachés et orientés pour transformer leurs idées en projets viables. Parallèlement, 26 conseillers de l’AGUIPE-E ont été outillés, 42 outils méthodologiques adaptés au contexte guinéen ont été développés et un référentiel opérationnel inédit a été mis en place. Autrement dit, nous n’avons pas seulement accompagné des jeunes : nous avons bâti un système… L’entrepreneuriat n’est pas une simple alternative à l’emploi salarié. Il est un instrument d’insertion, de création de revenus et de dynamisation des économies locales. Chaque jeune entrepreneur devient un acteur de transformation et un créateur d’opportunités. Notre ambition est claire : faire de l’accompagnement entrepreneurial un service permanent de l’AGUIPE-E, afin que chaque jeune en quête d’insertion trouve auprès de nous une porte d’entrée, qu’il s’agisse d’un emploi ou d’un projet d’entreprise », a déclaré Abdullah Konaté, directeur général adjoint de l’AGUIPE-E. Assurer l’avenir entrepreneurial de ces jeunes Guinéens, c’est l’ambition affichée par l’Agence belge de développement. Cette formation qu’elle vient d’assurer traduit son engagement à continuer de multiplier ses efforts dans sa collaboration avec la Guinée depuis plus d’une décennie, souligne Said Karmaoui, représentant d’Enabel en Guinée. « L’ambition commune est et continuera d’être de contribuer à créer davantage d’opportunités pour les jeunes et les femmes, afin qu’ils puissent construire leur avenir et participer pleinement à la croissance de leur pays. C’est dans cet esprit que le programme FIERE a soutenu la conception et le déploiement d’un programme pilote d’accompagnement entrepreneurial au sein de l’AGUIPE-E. Aujourd’hui, les résultats obtenus démontrent la pertinence de l’approche. En moins d’un an, près de 300 jeunes entrepreneurs en ont bénéficié, avec un taux de réalisation de 97 % des objectifs fixés. Ces jeunes, de Conakry, Kindia et Mamou, ont été accompagnés depuis la phase d’idéation jusqu’à la formalisation et à la préparation de leur projet entrepreneurial. Bravo aux 26 conseillers et conseillères de l’AGUIPE-E qui ont tenu bon dans ce parcours exigeant de formation et de coaching. Ils ont accepté de sortir de leur zone de confort, d’apprendre de nouvelles méthodes et de participer à cette expérience. Votre implication constitue la principale garantie de durabilité de ce que nous célébrons aujourd’hui », s’est-il réjoui. Le porte-parole des 300 bénéficiaires de cette formation a exprimé leur reconnaissance aux autorités guinéennes, à leur tête le chef de l’État, pour avoir placé la jeunesse au cœur de leur programme de gouvernance. Aboubacar Diallo a également salué la qualité de la formation reçue ainsi que le talent des formateurs. Ils entendent désormais lier la théorie à la pratique. « Je tiens à adresser mes sincères remerciements à Son Excellence Monsieur le Président de la République de Guinée pour sa vision et son engagement en faveur de la jeunesse, de l’emploi et de l’entrepreneuriat. Grâce aux réformes et aux initiatives mises en place, de nombreux jeunes ont aujourd’hui l’opportunité de développer leurs compétences et de construire leur avenir. Au nom de tous les bénéficiaires, je vous assure que nous mettrons en pratique les compétences acquises avec sérieux, responsabilité et détermination durant ce programme d’accompagnement des entrepreneurs que nous sommes. Nous nous engageons à contribuer activement au développement économique et social de notre chère Guinée. Que cette dynamique de soutien à la jeunesse se poursuive afin que chaque jeune Guinéen puisse avoir l’opportunité de réaliser son potentiel et de participer à la construction d’une Guinée prospère », a laissé entendre Aboubacar Diallo. La dynamique de transformation de la Guinée en véritable pôle économique à travers le programme Simandou 2040, c’est l’objectif que se fixent les autorités actuelles. Et cela passe forcément par la formation des jeunes, vecteur de développement. Selon le ministre du Commerce, de l’Industrie, des Petites et Moyennes Entreprises, cette formation qui vient de s’achever permet à la Guinée de franchir un grand pas. « Mesdames et Messieurs, aujourd’hui, nous ne célébrons pas seulement la fin de notre programme. Nous célébrons avant tout la réussite d’une vision. Nous célébrons la vision d’une Guinée où les jeunes ne sont pas uniquement des demandeurs d’emploi, mais également des créateurs de richesses, des bâtisseurs d’entreprises et des acteurs du développement national. Dans un contexte où le chômage et le sous-emploi continuent de constituer des défis majeurs, nous savons que l’avenir de notre pays dépendra de notre capacité à transformer l’énergie, le talent et la créativité de notre jeunesse en initiatives économiques viables et durables. Car chaque projet qui devient une entreprise, chaque entreprise qui se développe et chaque emploi qui est créé représente une victoire pour la Guinée. Le programme que nous clôturons aujourd’hui répond précisément à cette ambition. Son objectif n’était pas seulement d’accompagner quelques centaines de jeunes. Son ambition était plus profonde : combler un vide institutionnel, construire au sein de la Guinée un dispositif moderne d’accompagnement entrepreneurial et jeter les bases d’un mécanisme national capable d’aider les jeunes à passer de l’idée au projet, puis du projet à l’entreprise », a martelé Aboubacar Kourouma. Prenant la parole au nom du Premier ministre, chef du gouvernement, Lansana Béa Diallo a exprimé la reconnaissance de la Guinée à Enabel pour son accompagnement. Ce ministre de la Jeunesse a également mis l’accent sur la synergie d’action au sein de l’équipe gouvernementale. Pour lui, c’est le seul moyen qui permettra d’atteindre les résultats escomptés. Lansana Béa Diallo " data-large-file="https://i0.wp.com/mediaguinee.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/bfcdff3a-8a72-4fe8-aad3-cbe10c16ecfb.jpeg?fit=1008%2C567&ssl=1" class="wp-image-322822 size-full" src="https://i0.wp.com/mediaguinee.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/bfcdff3a-8a72-4fe8-aad3-cbe10c16ecfb.jpeg?resize=1008%2C567&ssl=1" alt="" width="1008" height="567" srcset="https://i0.wp.com/mediaguinee.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/bfcdff3a-8a72-4fe8-aad3-cbe10c16ecfb.jpeg?w=1008&ssl=1 1008w, https://i0.wp.com/mediaguinee.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/bfcdff3a-8a72-4fe8-aad3-cbe10c16ecfb.jpeg?resize=300%2C169&ssl=1 300w, https://i0.wp.com/mediaguinee.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/bfcdff3a-8a72-4fe8-aad3-cbe10c16ecfb.jpeg?resize=768%2C432&ssl=1 768w" sizes="(max-width: 1008px) 100vw, 1008px" /> Lansana Béa Diallo Il a par ailleurs assuré les récipiendaires de la disponibilité du gouvernement à les accompagner dans leurs projets. « Je tiens donc à remercier chaleureusement Enabel pour son engagement aux côtés de la Guinée. Vous savez, dans le sport, une équipe ne gagne pas parce qu’elle possède les meilleurs joueurs. On l’a vu avec la France et l’Espagne : magnifiques individualités, extraordinaire collectif. Une équipe gagne effectivement parce qu’elle est un collectif. Le meilleur attaquant ne marque pas sans une bonne passe. Le meilleur gardien ne gagne pas un match à lui seul. Chacun apporte sa compétence au service d’un objectif commun. Je crois profondément que c’est aussi ainsi que nous devons gouverner. Je veux saluer mon collègue, le ministre de l’Emploi, qui a parfaitement compris cette logique. Nos ministères ont des compétences différentes, mais ils sont complémentaires. Lorsque nous travaillons en transversalité, lorsque nous nous faisons effectivement confiance et que nous nous faisons les bonnes passes, ce sont les jeunes de Guinée qui gagnent et qui remportent cette victoire. Aujourd’hui, on est effectivement face à une parfaite illustration. Former un jeune à entreprendre, ce n’est pas seulement lui transmettre des connaissances, c’est lui donner les moyens de construire son avenir, de créer de la richesse, de créer des emplois et de participer au développement de notre pays. À vous, chers récipiendaires, je voudrais effectivement adresser un message simple. Ce satisfecit n’est pas une ligne d’arrivée, c’est une ligne de départ. N’ayez pas peur d’entreprendre, n’ayez pas peur d’échouer. Les plus grands entrepreneurs, comme les plus grands champions, ne sont pas ceux qui ne tombent jamais, mais plutôt ceux qui ont su se relever et toujours continuer. La boxe m’a appris une leçon essentielle. Ce ne sont pas les coups qui font un champion, mais sa capacité à se relever et à continuer d’avancer. Cette leçon vaut aussi pour l’entrepreneuriat. La Guinée a besoin d’une jeunesse qui ose, qui innove, qui crée des entreprises et qui crée des emplois. En tant que ministre de la Jeunesse, je veux vous assurer que notre département sera toujours un partenaire de toutes les initiatives qui permettent aux jeunes de développer leur potentiel. Je terminerai par un message très simple : croyez en vos rêves, mais surtout, travaillez chaque jour pour les transformer en réalité. Car chaque entreprise créée est une victoire pour la Guinée. Chaque emploi créé est une victoire pour votre jeunesse. N’attendez pas que l’avenir vous tende la main. Construisez-le et sachez que le gouvernement sera à vos côtés pour vous accompagner sur ce chemin. Chaque jeune qui réussit est une victoire pour toute la Guinée », a conclu le ministre Lansana Béa Diallo. items.title: Govt raises petrol price by Rs4.45, cuts HSD by Rs2
items.description: Pakistan fuel prices, 2026 Official ex-depot prices (PKR/litre) — OGRA & Ministry of Energy notifications Petrol (MS-92) Diesel (HSD) Pre-crisis baseline Source: OGRA / Ministry of Energy (Petroleum Division); Dawn.com · "> The government on Wednesday announced an increase of Rs4.45 per litre in the price of petrol and a reduction of Rs2 per litre in the price of high-speed diesel (HSD). Following the revision, petrol will retail at Rs333.01 per litre, while HSD will cost Rs383.86 per litre. The government continues to levy Rs110 per litre in taxes and duties on petrol and Rs96 per litre on diesel. The Petroleum Division’s notification said the new prices would be applicable for August 6 (Thursday). The diesel price has come down from a peak of Rs520.35 recorded on April 3. Its price had started rising from Rs281 per litre after the US-Iran war broke out on February 28. The petrol price had peaked at Rs458.41 on April 3 after beginning its upward trajectory from Rs266 in the first week of March. Earlier, Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik announced that fuel prices would now be fixed on a daily basis due to fluctuations in international market prices following renewed hostilities between Iran and the US. The government had been announcing weekly revisions to fuel prices since early March, alongside measures for the conservation of fuel amid possible oil supply disruptions due to the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. The federal government in April also announced targeted relief measures to provide subsidised fuel. The petroleum minister stated that the cabinet and the prime minister had decided to give the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (Ogra) the responsibility of deciding fuel prices on a daily basis based on international market trends. The daily pricing decision was rejected by the All Pakistan Dealers Association, which said it would consider a protest plan. Petrol is mainly used in private transport, small vehicles, rickshaws and two-wheelers, and changes in its price affect the middle and lower-middle classes. Similarly, changes in diesel prices also impact the public at large, as it is mainly used in the heavy transport sector, power plants and large generators. Petrol and high-speed diesel (HSD) are the major revenue earners, with monthly sales of about 700,000 to 800,000 tonnes, compared to just 10,000 tonnes of monthly demand for kerosene.

items.title: Le Ministre Bakary Yaou Sangaré reçoit le nouveau bureau du Haut Conseil des Nigériens à l’Extérieur et annonce la création d’une Maison de la Diaspora…
items.description: Le Ministre des Affaires étrangères, de la Coopération et des Nigériens à l’Extérieur, Son Excellence Monsieur Bakary Yaou Sangaré, a reçu en audience, mardi 4 août 2026, le bureau central nouvellement élu du Haut Conseil des Nigériens à l’Extérieur (HCNE). Composé de onze membres, ce bureau a été élu lors de l’Assemblée générale du HCNE tenue à Niamey du 30 au 31 juillet 2026. La rencontre avait pour objet une prise de contact officielle et la recherche de conseils et d’orientations auprès du Ministère de tutelle. Le Ministre s’est félicité du bon déroulement des élections, saluant leur caractère calme et transparent. Il a rappelé les missions dévolues au HCNE, insistant sur l’importance de la représentation, de la protection et de l’accompagnement des Nigériens vivant à l’étranger. Il a réaffirmé la disponibilité du Ministère à travailler en étroite collaboration avec le nouveau bureau pour promouvoir l’unité, la participation et le rayonnement de la diaspora nigérienne. S’appuyant sur cet engagement, Son Excellence Bakary Yaou Sangaré a annoncé la création prochaine d’une Maison de la Diaspora, structure destinée à centraliser les services, les activités culturelles et les initiatives de soutien aux Nigériens de l’extérieur. Il a également confirmé la subvention habituelle de l’État au fonctionnement du HCNE, gage du soutien institutionnel permanent envers cette instance. Au terme de l’audience, les deux parties ont convenu d’œuvrer de concert pour atteindre les objectifs qui leur ont été fixés, notamment le renforcement du lien entre la diaspora et la mère patrie, la facilitation des actions de développement portées par les Nigériens à l’étranger, et l’amélioration des mécanismes de protection et d’assistance consulaire. items.title: 3FPT : Soulèye Kane prend les rênes, promet d’anticiper les besoins du marché
items.description: Soulèye Kane est désormais aux commandes du Fonds de Financement de la Formation professionnelle et technique (3FPT). L'inspecteur principal a été officiellement installé, ce mercredi 5 août, dans ses fonctions de Directeur général du 3FPT, à l'issue d'une cérémonie de passation de service avec son prédécesseur, le Dr Amadou Babo Ba, qui aura passé deux ans et deux mois à la tête de l'institution, marqués par la mise en place de huit projets. Nommé en Conseil des ministres le 16 juillet dernier, le nouveau DG n'est pas un inconnu de la maison. Il occupait auparavant le poste de Directeur de l'Apprentissage au ministère de la Formation professionnelle, avant de gravir l'échelon suprême de cette institution chargée de financer la formation professionnelle et technique du pays. Son parcours académique éclaire cette nomination. Major de sa promotion à l'École Normale Supérieure d'Enseignement Technique et Professionnel de Dakar, Soulèye Kane y décroche un Certificat d'Aptitude à l'Inspectorat de Spécialité avant de compléter sa formation par un Master en Sciences politiques à l'IEP de Toulouse et un diplôme en Management des politiques publiques au Korea Development Institute. Une double culture technique et managériale qui a nourri plus de 26 ans de carrière dans le pilotage des politiques de formation, jusqu'au poste stratégique de Directeur de l'Apprentissage. Devant l'assistance, M. Kane a dessiné les contours de son mandat : renforcement des partenariats avec le secteur privé, développement de l'apprentissage traditionnel, adéquation entre offres de formation et besoins réels du marché de l’emploi. « Le financement de la formation ne doit plus seulement suivre la demande ; il doit anticiper les besoins réels du marché », a-t-il martelé, plaçant les jeunes, les femmes et la compétitivité des entreprises au cœur de sa feuille de route. Le nouveau Directeur général a également pris l'engagement d'une gestion fondée sur la transparence, la rigueur et l'équité territoriale, promettant un accès équitable à la formation et à l'insertion professionnelle sur l'ensemble du territoire national. La cérémonie, tenue dans les locaux du 3FPT, a réuni les autorités du ministère de tutelle, les membres du Conseil d'administration, le personnel de l'institution ainsi que plusieurs acteurs de la formation professionnelle et technique. Un passage de témoin, mais une ambition affichée : faire du 3FPT un outil d'anticipation, non plus seulement de suivi.

items.title: GHS calls for stronger national support for breastfeeding as Ghana marks World Breastfeeding Week
items.description: The Ghana Health Service (GHS) has called for stronger national support for breastfeeding, urging families, employers, communities and policymakers to play a more active role in helping mothers breastfeed successfully. The appeal was made as Ghana joined the rest of the world in commemorating World Breastfeeding Week 2026 and Ghana’s Breastfeeding Month, with this year’s campaign focusing on strengthening systems that protect, promote and support breastfeeding. In a statement issued on Wednesday, August 5, the GHS said the 2026 theme highlights the need to monitor progress, learn from successful interventions and improve policies and programmes that enable mothers to breastfeed their children. The Service described breastfeeding as one of the most effective ways of improving child survival and development, noting that while breastfeeding is a natural process, mothers require significant support to practise it successfully. According to the GHS, breastmilk provides infants with the nutrients they need during the early stages of life while protecting them against several life-threatening diseases. The Service said breastfeeding helps prevent illnesses such as diarrhoea and pneumonia, offers long-term protection against common allergies, promotes cognitive development and supports the healthy development of facial and dental muscles. It also noted that breastfeeding contributes to better long-term health by reducing the risk of overweight and obesity later in life, adding that healthier children ultimately contribute to a more productive workforce and national economic growth. “Breastmilk is, indeed, a super food. Mothers, however, need immense support to practice this life saving intervention,” the statement said. As part of this year’s commemoration, the Ghana Health Service said it would reinforce breastfeeding support across the country’s primary healthcare system. The Service plans to review existing breastfeeding interventions, identify gaps in implementation and strengthen approaches that have proven effective over the years. According to the GHS, education will remain its principal strategy, with healthcare workers continuing to provide information, practical assistance and follow-up support for mothers and their families at health facilities. The initiative forms part of broader efforts to improve maternal, newborn and child health, reduce malnutrition and preventable childhood illnesses, strengthen primary healthcare and advance Universal Health Coverage. The Service also said promoting breastfeeding supports Ghana’s efforts to ensure every child has the best possible start in life, regardless of where they are born. “Breastfeeding is the great equalizer,” the statement noted. The Ghana Health Service stressed that supporting breastfeeding should not be left solely to mothers or health professionals. It called on employers to introduce family-friendly workplace policies, including adequate maternity protection, flexible working arrangements, breastfeeding breaks and designated spaces where mothers can safely express and store breastmilk. The Service also urged the media to continue promoting the benefits of breastfeeding while avoiding the promotion of breastmilk substitutes. Employee associations were encouraged to advocate stronger workplace support for breastfeeding mothers, while families and communities were urged to provide practical and emotional support to women during the breastfeeding period. The GHS further appealed to fathers to play a more active role in supporting breastfeeding mothers, describing family support as critical to successful exclusive breastfeeding. Civil society organisations and advocacy groups were also encouraged to continue promoting breastfeeding as a public health and economic investment. In addition, the Service called on Members of Parliament to support legislation and allocate resources that strengthen breastfeeding policies and programmes across the country. “This August, and beyond, let us stand with every breastfeeding mother. Let us protect what works, improve what needs attention, and ensure that no mother or child is left behind,” the statement said. The Service emphasised that breastfeeding is a shared national responsibility requiring the commitment of government institutions, employers, healthcare providers, communities and families to ensure that every child receives the best possible nutritional start in life. “Breastfeeding is not the responsibility of mothers alone. It is a shared national responsibility.”

items.title: Newcastle appoint Jaissle as new head coach
items.description: Newcastle have appointed Matthias Jaissle as their new head coach following Eddie Howe’s departure, the English Premier League club announced Wednesday. The 38-year-old Jaissle, a former Germany Under-21 international, was previously in charge of Saudi side Al-Ahli but has no prior experience of managing a top-flight club. “It is an incredible honour to become head coach of Newcastle United,” said Jaissle. “This is one of the biggest clubs in European football, with a unique history, identity and supporter base, and I am excited to experience that passion and connection first-hand. “When Newcastle United comes your way, you take notice. The ambition of the club, the vision for the future and the opportunity ahead made this an incredibly compelling place to be. I have followed the club’s journey closely in recent years and the progress that has been made is clear for everyone to see.” Jaissle was forced to end his playing career due to injury at the age of 25. His first managerial job came with Austrian side Liefering, whom he led to a second-placed finish in the second tier, the club’s joint best-ever position. Jaissle took charge at Red Bull Salzburg in 2021, winning successive Austrian titles as well as the Austrian Cup. Jaissle joined Al-Ahli in 2023 and led them to AFC Champions League titles in 2025 and 2026. In his five years at Newcastle, Howe revitalised a club that had struggled for decades. He replaced Steve Bruce in November 2021 and won the League Cup in March 2025 — beating Liverpool in the final to clinch the northeast side’s first major trophy since 1969. The former Bournemouth boss also led Newcastle to Champions League qualification in 2023 and 2025. But hampered by star striker Alexander Isak’s protracted move to Liverpool, Howe came under pressure as the Magpies finished 12th in the Premier League last season, with 17 defeats in their 38 games. Newcastle reached the Champions League last 16 but were hammered 8-3 on aggregate by Barcelona. The club have since been depleted by the close-season departures of Italy midfielder Sandro Tonali to Tottenham and England forward Anthony Gordon to Barcelona. The post Newcastle appoint Jaissle as new head coach appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: NIS dispels fears, says passport processing continues nationwide
items.description: By Omeiza Ajayi ABUJA: The Nigeria Immigration Service NIS has assured Nigerians that the ongoing centralisation of passport booklet production will not disrupt passport processing and issuance at any of its offices across the country or at Nigerian embassies and consulates abroad. The clarification was contained in a statement on Wednesday night by the Service Public Relations Officer, DCI Akinsola Akinlabi, who said the reform had generated public enquiries and misconceptions following the phased migration of passport production from state passport offices to the Central Personalization Centre at the NIS Headquarters in Abuja. According to the Service, the migration is strictly an operational reform designed to modernise Nigeria’s passport issuance system by strengthening its security, integrity and efficiency, and does not affect the ability of applicants to process or obtain passports from their preferred passport offices. “The migration of production in passport offices to the Central Personalization Centre is purely operational and does not in any way stop the processing and issuance of passport at any passport office within the country or at designated Nigeria’s Embassies and Consulates abroad,” the statement said. The NIS explained that the reform is being implemented through a five-phase migration plan aimed at reducing operational risks, preventing service disruptions and ensuring seamless nationwide implementation. It disclosed that the first three phases of the programme have already been completed, covering passport offices in the North Central, North East, South East, South South, North West and parts of the South West, as well as dozens of Nigerian diplomatic missions across Africa, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, the Americas and Oceania. The fourth phase, scheduled for August 2026, will onboard passport offices in Gombe, Adamawa, Taraba, Bauchi, Kano, Rivers, Cross River, Akwa Ibom and Bayelsa states, while the final phase, expected to be completed before the end of the year, will cover Lagos passport offices and Nigerian missions in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada. Under the new operational framework, all passport booklets will now be printed and security-personalised exclusively at a secure, centralised and high-capacity production hub located at the NIS Headquarters in Abuja. The Service said the arrangement would enable passports to be produced and dispatched to passport offices across Nigeria and overseas missions within two weeks, while all passport offices would continue to function as centres for application processing and issuance. It added that the centralisation would eliminate manual intervention in the passport personalisation process, curb document arbitrage, improve accountability and guarantee uniform quality standards with enhanced security features embedded in every Nigerian passport. The NIS urged applicants to continue accessing passport services at their preferred passport offices, stressing that the reform would not alter existing application procedures. Reaffirming its commitment to improved service delivery, the Service said it would continue deploying technology-driven solutions to safeguard the integrity of Nigeria’s passport system in line with international best practices. KTU hostel crackdown: Rent Control, GTA shut down two facilities over poor sanitation, arbitrary rent concerns
items.description: The Rent Control Commission and the Ghana Tourism Authority (GTA) have shut down two private hostels serving students of Koforidua Technical University (KTU) over poor sanitation, substandard living conditions and regulatory breaches. The affected facilities, Serwaa Heights and Adehye3 Hostel, were closed following complaints by students, who also raised concerns about unsanitary conditions and what they described as arbitrary rent increases. Officials from the Eastern Regional Office of the Ghana Tourism Authority, led by the Regional Director, Jones Haruna Nelson, and the Acting Rent Control Commissioner, Frederick Opoku, carried out an unannounced inspection of hostel facilities around the university after receiving complaints from students. The inspection team first met with the Dean of Students before briefing the Vice-Chancellor on the purpose of the exercise. Their first stop was Serwaa Heights, located about 300 metres from the university’s small gate, where officials observed poor sanitation and unsatisfactory management conditions. The Ghana Tourism Authority also discovered that the hostel was operating without the required registration. “We came and realised that the place is not fit for purpose. We didn’t know there were hostels here because they are doing illegal business. The place is unkempt, the air coming in is bad, so we have served them a notice of closure,” Mr Haruna Nelson told journalists. Students at the hostel told Channel One TV they were paying GH¢9,000 a year for single rooms and GH¢5,000 each for shared accommodation occupied by three students, despite the poor living conditions. The inspection team later visited Adehye3 Hostel, located behind the university’s main campus, where they found heaps of refuse at the entrance and other sanitation concerns. Students there also expressed frustration over the conditions and called for the facility to be closed. Following the inspections, the Ghana Tourism Authority issued closure notices to both hostels. Mr Haruna Nelson said the action was necessary to protect students and ensure hostel operators comply with the standards required to operate legally. Acting Rent Control Commissioner Frederick Opoku assured affected students that they would receive refunds for monies already paid and said the Commission would work closely with the Ghana Tourism Authority to safeguard the welfare of students renting private accommodation. He said the two institutions would continue to inspect hostel facilities to ensure students have access to accommodation that meets acceptable health and safety standards. Mr Opoku also vowed to clamp down on hostel operators exploiting students through poor facilities and unjustified rent charges. He added that the Commission, in collaboration with the Ghana Tourism Authority, would sustain the nationwide exercise to identify and close unlicensed and unsanitary hostel facilities.

items.title: Govt will complete tenure, Shehbaz to remain PM for five years: Naqvi
items.description: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi on Wednesday said the incumbent government would complete its constitutional term and Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif would remain in office for the full five-year tenure. Naqvi made the remarks while speaking to the media outside the Interior Ministry in Islamabad, a week after saying the country’s governance system had “collapsed” and arguing that Pakistan needed new administrative units, or provinces, to improve service delivery, accountability and access to justice. A day later, the military’s spokesperson also called on political parties to consider an administrative reset to improve governance, arguing that the country’s security and stability depended on adapting its governance structure to the demands of modern times and a growing population. “The future for the government is the completion of its five-year tenure … Shehbaz sahib will remain the prime minister for five years … the prime minister will complete his five-year term,” Naqvi maintained. When asked whether his remarks about the “collapse” of the system amounted to a “charge sheet” against the government, Naqvi said he stood by his statement, maintaining that “the system has been destroyed”. He clarified that he was referring to the country’s “80-year-old [administrative] system”. “Even today, I maintain that the system that has been in place for the last 80 years is destroyed, because if it had been functioning, Pakistan would have reached new heights,” he said. Naqvi clarified that he had not “charge-sheeted” the government, saying he himself was part of the same administration. “If you have a prime minister who works 14 to 16 hours a day, and if the current situation improves, the results will be a thousand times better,” he said. Elaborating on the achievements of the prime minister and the incumbent government, the interior minister said that the Federal Board of Revenue’s (FBR) revenue had increased manifold, Pakistan had won a war against India, its diplomatic standing had improved significantly worldwide, and numerous reforms had been introduced. “I still believe today that if the prime minister had operated within a better system, he could have taken this country forward a hundred times more,” Naqvi said, while highlighting the efforts made by the premier. He also briefly referred to certain individuals who wanted to create differences between him and Shehbaz. Naqvi’s earlier remarks had sparked a political controversy, drawing criticism from government allies, opposition parties and other political figures. Responding to the interior minister’s call for an overhaul of the country’s governance structure, Defence Minister Khawaja Asif advised him to begin the process by implementing the National Action Plan (NAP) and bringing reforms to his own ministry. Asif further noted that Naqvi had held a “very powerful position” in the system for the past three years. The PPP also demanded the resignation of Naqvi, accusing him of undermining the Constitution by “endorsing a hybrid system”, declaring that the country’s democratic system of governance had collapsed and calling for the creation of new provinces . Meanwhile, former Senate chairman Mian Raza Rabbani strongly opposed the proposal to create new provinces , arguing that Pakistan’s governance failures stem from violations of the Constitution rather than the existing federating units. In a detailed statement, he cautioned that redrawing administrative boundaries would not resolve the country’s deep-rooted systemic issues. Instead, he said, the real causes of the governance crisis are the erosion of provincial autonomy and the weakening of democratic institutions. Naqvi’s controversial remarks came on the same day that he met President Asif Ali Zardari at Bilawal House, where they reviewed “the country’s overall law and order situation, with a particular focus on security conditions in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan.

items.description: Un nouveau-né de sexe féminin a été retrouvé vivant dans une fosse septique, ce mercredi 5 août 2026, au quartier Dogora, dans la commune urbaine de Labé. Cette découverte a provoqué une vive émotion parmi les habitants de la localité. Selon les premières informations, l'alerte a été donnée dans la matinée par des riverains après la découverte du bébé dans une toilette située au secteur 1 du quartier. Informés, les responsables locaux, les services de la protection civile ainsi que les forces de sécurité se sont rapidement rendus sur les lieux. Grâce à l'intervention des agents de la protection civile, qui ont dû casser une partie de la fosse septique pour extraire l'enfant, le nouveau-né a pu être sauvé. Il a ensuite été transporté d'urgence à l'hôpital régional de Labé où il reçoit ses premiers soins. Interrogé par la presse locale, le président du conseil de quartier de Doguora, Moussa Cissoko, est revenu sur les circonstances de cette intervention. « C'est aux environs de 8 heures que j'ai été informé qu'un nouveau-né avait été découvert dans une toilette au secteur 1. Je me suis immédiatement rendu sur les lieux pour constater les faits. J'ai ensuite alerté les agents de la protection civile qui ont réussi à casser la toilette afin de sortir le bébé. Heureusement, il était encore en vie. Notre priorité était de lui sauver la vie avant de l'évacuer à l'hôpital régional de Labé pour les premiers soins. La gendarmerie est également arrivée sur les lieux et a ouvert une enquête. C'est une situation regrettable, surtout lorsque l'on sait que de nombreuses personnes souhaitent avoir des enfants. Il aurait été préférable de confier ce bébé à une personne responsable plutôt que de l'abandonner ainsi. À notre connaissance, cet enfant n'est pas né dans notre quartier ; il aurait été déposé dans cette toilette », a-t-il déclaré. Les autorités compétentes ont ouvert une enquête afin d'identifier et de retrouver la mère du nouveau-né. Pour l'heure, aucune personne n'a encore été interpellée dans cette affaire. Alpha Moussa Dieng L’article Labé : un nouveau-né retrouvé vivant dans une fosse septique à Dogora, une enquête ouverte est apparu en premier sur Mediaguinee.com .

items.title: Two jailed 20 years for trafficking Nigerians into cybercrime in Tema
items.description: The Tema Regional Police Command has secured a 20-year prison sentence for two men convicted of trafficking Nigerian nationals into Ghana under the false promise of employment before forcing them into cybercrime. Kingsley Ndifon, 29, and Emmanuel Akong, 25, were convicted of human trafficking and causing harm following a trial at Circuit Court ‘B’ in Tema. According to the Police, the two men were arrested on 20 August 2023 at Sebrepor, a suburb of Tema, after the Afienya District Police Command received a distress call that several people were being held in a house against their will. A police patrol team, assisted by residents, stormed the house and rescued 11 Nigerian nationals who had been confined there. The officers also arrested the two suspects at the scene. During a search of the premises, the Police recovered 16 laptops and an iPad from rooms occupied by the suspects. Investigations revealed that the victims had been recruited from Nigeria with promises of employment in Ghana. However, upon arriving in the country, they were allegedly forced to engage in cyber-related criminal activities while being held captive in the house at Sebrepor. Police said the suspects confiscated the victims’ mobile phones and identification cards before compelling them to carry out internet fraud using laptops provided to them. The investigation further uncovered disturbing details about the victims’ treatment. According to the Police, the victims were fed only once a day and were subjected to severe physical abuse whenever they failed to follow instructions. “They were allegedly beaten with laptop cables and machetes, resulting in injuries, including cutlass wounds,” the Police said in a statement. Investigators also found that the victims were malnourished and in poor health at the time they were rescued. The two accused persons were subsequently arraigned before Circuit Court ‘B’ in Tema, presided over by Her Honour Naomi Adusei Amamiampong Kucour. They faced charges of conspiracy to commit crime, namely human trafficking, human trafficking, and causing harm. At the end of the trial, the court found Kingsley Ndifon and Emmanuel Akong guilty of human trafficking and causing harm. The court sentenced each of them to 20 years’ imprisonment for human trafficking and 10 years’ imprisonment for causing harm. The sentences are to run concurrently, meaning each convict will serve 20 years in prison. Commenting on the case, the Tema Regional Police Command reaffirmed its commitment to tackling human trafficking and related crimes. “The Tema Regional Police Command remains committed to combating human trafficking, cyber-related crimes and all forms of abuse,” the Police said. The Command also urged members of the public to promptly report suspected cases of human trafficking and other criminal activities to the Police.

items.description: ​Le Tunisien Adam El Salmi a décroché la médaille d'or lors du tournoi international d'Indonésie (G2), marquant une étape majeure dans sa carrière internationale. Dans un communiqué publié ce mercredi 5 août 2026, le Comité national olympique tunisien (Cnot) a félicité le jeune taekwondoïste, engagé dans la catégorie des -63 kg, affirmant qu'il a livré une prestation magistrale en finale face au Russe Kantemir Bitsuev, s'imposant haut la main deux manches à zéro (12-5 et 12-3). ​Cette victoire rapporte de précieux points à Adam Selmi dans sa quête des sommets internationaux avec 30 points accumulés en l'espace de deux semaines, il est parvenu à faire un bond géant au classement mondial, integrant ainsi le Top 10. ​Le Cnot CNOT a tenu à adresser ses plus chaleureuses félicitations au champion pour ce succès retentissant qui fait à nouveau briller le drapeau tunisien sur la scène internationale, lit-on encore dans le communiqué. items.title: Labé : un quatrième cas de noyade enregistré à Dionfo
items.description: La préfecture de Labé continue d'enregistrer des cas de noyade en cette saison des pluies. Un jeune homme a perdu la vie ce mardi 4 août 2026 dans un marigot situé entre les localités de Koncosoré et Hamaré, dans la commune rurale de Dionfo. La victime, identifiée comme Ousmane Diallo et originaire du village de Hamaré (district de Ndeylal), s'était rendue au marigot pour prendre un bain lorsqu'elle s'est noyée, selon des informations recueillies auprès de sources locales. Des habitants indiquent que le jeune homme souffrait de malaises récurrents pouvant entraîner des pertes de connaissance. Toutefois, il n'est pas encore établi si cet état de santé est lié à sa disparition. Ce décès a provoqué une vive émotion au sein de la population. Selon nos informations, l'inhumation est prévue ce mercredi 5 août à Hamaré. Pour rappel, il s'agit du quatrième cas de noyade enregistré dans la préfecture de Labé depuis le début de la saison des pluies, une situation qui appelle à davantage de vigilance aux abords des cours d'eau et des marigots. items.title: Fire guts late Murtala Mohammed’s family home, destroys nine rooms
items.description: A fire has destroyed nine of the 17 rooms at the family home of the late Tamale Central Member of Parliament, Murtala Mohammed, in Tamale. The blaze broke out on Wednesday, August 5, prompting a swift response from the Ghana National Fire Service (GNFS). According to the Northern Regional Public Relations Officer of the GNFS, ADO I Hudu Baba, the Service received a distress call at 3:29 p.m. , and firefighters arrived at the scene eight minutes later at 3:37 p.m. Speaking to Accra-based Channel One News, ADO I Hudu Baba said firefighters rescued two schoolchildren who had become trapped in one of the rooms before bringing the fire under control. He noted that while the fire destroyed nine rooms in the building, efforts by the firefighters prevented it from spreading to the remaining sections of the house. The GNFS has since launched an investigation to determine the cause of the fire and assess the full extent of the damage. Murtala Mohammed was among the eight people who lost their lives in the military helicopter crash in the Adansi area of the Ashanti Region on August 6, 2025. The victims were travelling from Accra to the Ashanti Region on an official assignment when the helicopter crashed. The accident claimed the lives of Defence Minister Dr Edward Omane Boamah, Environment Minister Ibrahim Murtala Mohammed, Acting Deputy National Security Coordinator Alhaji Limuna Muniru Mohammed, National Democratic Congress (NDC) National Vice Chairman Dr Samuel Sarpong, former parliamentary candidate Samuel Aboagye, and three military crew members.
